verdict.rationale: Dynadot ships an official MCP server that lets users manage domains by talking to an AI assistant. It covers checking availability, registering domains, viewing domains and account info, and reviewing nameservers and DNS records. Its AI Domain Search also takes a keyword or phrase. The documented natural-language operations are a narrow subset of the product, so this is partial rather than full. Missing for 10: documented natural-language coverage of DNS edits, transfers, renewals, aftermarket and account settings; any hands-on or independent corroboration of the MCP experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Dynadot MCP is an easier way to manage your domains, just by talking to an AI assistant.

Check a domain name availability
*   Register domains for you
*   View your domains and account info
*   Review nameservers and DNS records
Dynadot AI Domain Search generates domain name suggestions from your keyword or phrase
